d: The Pardeep Narwal and Monu Goyat combination reigned supreme in the Pro Kabaddi League Season 5 final as Patna Pirates beat Gujarat Giants by 17 points. Patna Pirates became the first team to win three PKL titles on the trot. The 1000th PKL Panga is set to be played on January 15 between Bengal Warriors and Bengaluru Bulls.
